paper.title_en: Exact stress-tensor fluctuations from conformal symmetry and black hole radiation
paper.abstract_en: Semiclassical gravity is sourced by the expectation value of the stress tensor, and it is reliable only if the fluctuations around this value are small. In two dimensions, conformal symmetry captures the essential physics of Hawking radiation in its s-wave sector and determines the mean value exactly, for any background and any quantum state. We show that it also determines the local fluctuations of the null components $T_{\pm\pm}$. The square of the stress tensor is defined by the operator product expansion, up to a multiple $α$ of $\partial_\pm^2T_{\pm\pm}$ that labels point-splitting prescriptions. Its transformation law under the conformal map to locally inertial coordinates gives the variance in closed form. The relative fluctuation scales as $1/c$, with $c$ the central charge. For the Schwarzschild black hole it is $22/5c$ for the Hawking flux at infinity, that of flat-space thermal radiation. At the horizon it is $-44α/3c$ for the outgoing flux and $(238+720α)/5c$ for the ingoing flux that drives the backreaction. Both reduce to $22/5c$ for $α=-3/10$, which corresponds to the Möbius-covariant prescription. For large $c$ these results support the semiclassical approximation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在二维共形对称框架下精确计算了零分量的应力张量局域涨落，并给出史瓦西黑洞霍金通量及视界处涨落的闭式结果，涉及半经典引力与霍金辐射的基础问题，理论深度较高、推导清晰，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 由共形对称性与黑洞辐射给出的精确应力张量涨落
decision.abstract_zh: 半经典引力由应力张量的期望值作为源，只有当该期望值附近的涨落很小时才是可靠的。在二维情形下，共形对称性在其 s 波扇区中抓住了霍金辐射的本质物理，并对任意背景和任意量子态精确地确定了均值。我们证明，它也同样确定了零分量 $T_{\pm\pm}$ 的局域涨落。应力张量的平方由算符乘积展开定义，最多相差 $\partial_\pm^2T_{\pm\pm}$ 的一个倍数 $α$，该倍数标记了点分裂方案。其在到局部惯性坐标的共形映射下的变换律给出了闭合形式的方差。相对涨落按 $1/c$ 标度，其中 $c$ 为中心荷。对于史瓦西黑洞，无穷远处霍金通量的相对涨落为 $22/5c$，即平直空间热辐射的相应值。在视界处，出射通量的相对涨落为 $-44α/3c$，而驱动反作用的入射通量为 $(238+720α)/5c$。当 $α=-3/10$ 时二者都化为 $22/5c$，这对应于 Möbius 协变方案。对于大 $c$，这些结果支持半经典近似。
